note: Barton County (KS) publishes its zoning only as static adopted PDF maps (General Zoning Map, Dec 2025; Official Zoning Map, 2024). Its Mapping/GIS pages and ORKA services (services.kansasgis.org ORKA KS_ORKA_Extras) have parcels, city limits and boundaries but no zoning district layer. The largest city, Great Bend, also publishes its zoning map only as PDF, noting it is not the official map; its ArcGIS Online org has only a lead service line inventory map. No queryable zoning polygon service was found for the county or Great Bend.
